name: Harbor Lane onboarding diagnostic

brief.objective: Set up monthly closes for a small coffee roaster: map the chart of accounts, tie opening balances to the FY2026 closing trial balance and write the categorization rulebook and close checklist.

notes: Opening balances tie exactly. Expect the Venmo payment and Check payees to be low-confidence rules, suspense accounts 1999 and 6999 flagged in the map, and open questions about the Ask My Accountant balance.
